Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this exciting Test match which ultimately ends in a draw, but both teams put up a decent fight to force a result. However, both these sides will have another chance to win the series in the second and final Test. That game will start on 12th February at 1.30 pm IST(8 am GMT). You can join us early for the build-up though. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Tagenarine Chanderpaul is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for scoring an unbeaten 207 in the first inning. He says that it was good to go out there and get some runs. Adds that the pitch was spinning a bit and that playing in the practice game helped him a lot. Mentions his double hundred and the record-opening partnership with Kraigg Brathwaite is something to cherish and they will try it go from strength to strength.

Craig Ervine the captain of Zimbabwe says that the last over felt like forever but says it was an exciting Test. Adds that there was a lot of fight from his boys after getting no wickets on Day 1. Credits Gary Ballance and Brandon Mavuta for their partnership and says that got them back in the game. Mentions that he has given the freedom to his team to express themselves on the field and is proud of his boys. Ends by saying that the squad will be the same for the Second Test.

Kraigg Brathwaite the skipper of West Indies says that after losing almost a day due to rain it was a commendable effort from them to push for the win. Adds that after the first innings, they had a feeling that they could bowl the hosts out twice and praises his bowlers for trying hard but also credits Gary Ballance and other Zimbabwe batters. Mentions that early wickets could have been crucial, but is happy with their performance. Ends by saying that he was not surprised with the performance of Tagenarine Chanderpaul and says that he is a fighter and this is just the start of great things to come for him.
Time for the presentations...

Zimbabwe started their first inning well but lost three wickets just before Stumps on Day 3 and were in a precarious position. The morning session on Day 4 did not go too well for them as they lost four wickets and were looking at following on which would have made this game go completely in West Indies' favor. The turning point in the game arrived when Jason Holder dropped Brandon Mavuta when he had just arrived at the wicket and he went on to score a half-century adding 135 runs with Gary Ballance for the eighth wicket. The latter reached his century on debut for Zimbabwe and remained unbeaten as Craig Ervine opted to declare with them still trailing by 68 runs. This was the move that changed the course of the game as it got both teams believing that they can get the better of their opponent. We hope this game is just the trailer and we experience a blockbuster in the series decider provided the rain gods do not spoil the party.

The game did not get off to a great start as there were just 51 overs bowled on Day 1 due to rain interruptions and West Indies looked to be watchful scoring 112 runs without losing any wickets. Both opening batters were unbeaten on 55 and they continued from where they left off on Day 2. Rain once again had a massive role to play as the game resumed only for the final session in which West Indies remained wicketless once again and took the opening partnership to 221 with both batters scoring their hundreds in the process. The opening partnership ended on Day 3 with 336 on the board after which West Indies lost quick wickets in the bid to accelerate the scoring. Kraigg Brathwaite made a remarkable 182 while Tagenarine Chanderpaul remained unbeaten on 207 as the visitors declared with 447 runs on the board and having lost 6 wickets. Brandon Mavuta claimed a five-wicket haul but his main contribution came with the bat.

West Indies wanted to get in as many overs as possible before Stumps with them turning mainly to spin and even Jason Holder and Kyle Mayers decided to turn into spinners in a quest for wickets. Gudakesh Motie did the bulk of the damage taking four wickets while Roston Chase chipped in with two as well. Earlier in the day, the openers were dismissed early but half-centuries from Raymon Reifer and Jermaine Blackwood helped them set a target of 272 for the hosts. Wellington Masakadza and Brad Evans claimed three and two wickets respectively as Zimbabwe hunted for a win themselves but the target set for them was too steep and it did not look likely that they would be able to chase it down. Both teams tried their best though and it bodes well for the next game as we know that both teams will be looking for a win to seal the series.

This game was headed for a draw but we had some exciting action in the final session as West Indies claimed six wickets in the Zimbabwe second innings and were four wickets away from registering an unlikely win. Zimbabwe played just three balls before rain halted play and the umpires decided to take early Tea. The openers came out looking to be positive but lost Tanunurwa Makoni early after which Chamu Chibhabha got together with Innocent Kaia and put together a 47-run partnership. They looked like they were building towards an exciting run chase but they lost both set batters along with the skipper Craig Ervine for 22 runs. Gary Ballance and Tafadzwa Tsiga decided to play for time thereafter and once again the game looked like it was heading for a draw but the wickets of the former and Brad Evans gave West Indies hope once again. Wellington Masakadza faced 36 deliveries without scoring a run and along with Tafadzwa Tsiga closed the game out.

Despite the rain intervals, full credit must be given to both teams as they looked to push for a result in this game. With the first three innings being declared, it is fair to say that both teams fancied their chances in this game and a drawn game is a fair result for the effort they have put into this match. West Indies believed that they could win this game right till the end and tried really hard but Zimbabwe managed to block them out for several overs.

Tossed up, full and on middle, Chamu Chibhabha works it towards short mid-wicket.
Flights this one full and outside the off pole. Craig Ervine knocks this towards mid off.
FOUR! Craig Ervine looking to play his shots against the spinner! Gudakesh Motie flights this full and outside off. Craig Ervine sweeps this fine towards the fine leg fence for four runs.
Bowls this full and on the pads. Craig Ervine clips this towards mid-wicket.
Bowls this quicker as he sees the batter come down the wicket. Craig Ervine is hurried into the shot and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Easy pickings for the Zimbabwe skipper and he obliges! A low full toss outside off. Craig Ervine whips this towards deep mid-wicket for his first boundary.
Gudakesh Motie flights this full and outside the off stump. Craig Ervine gets well across and attempts to reverse sweep this but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Quicker again, full and on middle, Chamu Chibhabha blocks it towards short mid-wicket.
Darts this one full and on middle, Chamu Chibhabha defends it to the leg side.
Looped up, full and on middle, Chamu Chibhabha nudges it towards square leg.
Floated, full and on off, Craig Ervine drives it past the cover fielder for a single.
Quicker, full and on off again, Craig Ervine keeps it out to the off side.
Kraigg Brathwaite starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on off, Craig Ervine pushes it towards covers.
Flights this on full and outside leg. Chamu Chibhabha gets forward and defends this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this full and on the pads. Craig Ervine clips this towards square leg to open his account with a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gudakesh Motie bowling on a leg-stump line has worked for West Indies as they have broken this partnership and Innocent Kaia has to make the long walk back to the shed! This is floated really full and Innocent Kaia looks to clip this away but there is too much bottom hand in his shot. He ends up lobbing the ball into the hands of the mid-wicket fielder where Kraigg Brathwaite has the easiest of the catches to take. Do West Indies have an opening here with both the Zimbabwe openers back in the dressing room?
Commentary.Howout: c Kraigg Brathwaite b Gudakesh Motie

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks! Zimbabwe were building a good partnership, but they lost Innocent Kaia just at the wrong time. Now, they have to rebuild again and avoid losing wickets too. West Indies, on the other hand will feel like this is their opening and they will go hard at the hosts to a get a few quick wickets. The last phase of the last day of this Test match should be very enthralling. Also, Craig Ervine walks out to bat now.
This is short and on a leg stump line. Chamu Chibhabha rocks back and flicks this towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Chamu Chibhabha gets a hold of this one and collects a boundary! Gudakesh Motie serves this short and on a leg stump line. Chamu Chibhabha pulls this wide of deep square leg and gets four runs.
Gudakesh Motie floats this full and outside the leg stump. Innocent Kaia clears his front foot and looks to slog sweep this. Does not connect well and gets the ball to deep square leg for a single.
Attacks the stumps on a good length. Chamu Chibhabha clips this towards the mid-wicket fielder. Jason Holder bowls a maiden here.
Goes back to bowling short and outside off. Chamu Chibhabha stands tall and dabs this down into the leg side.
Nails the yorker this time and serves this in line with the stumps. Chamu Chibhabha gets his bat down in time and keeps the ball out.
Bowls this one on a good length and in line with the stumps. Chamu Chibhabha clips this towards square leg as well.
Back of a length once again and outside off. Chamu Chibhabha is unable to get this past square leg.
Jason Holder starts the over with a shot ball outside off. Chamu Chibhabha pulls this straight to the square-leg fielder.
Continues to attack the pads on a shorter length. Chamu Chibhabha whips this towards deep backward square leg and takes a single to retain strike.
Fires this one full and outside the leg stump. Chamu Chibhabha tries to flick it leg side but gets a leading edge towards third man. They pick up a couple of runs.
Floats this one full and on a leg stump line. Chamu Chibhabha clips this towards mid-wicket.
Tosses this one outside the off stump on a fuller length. Chamu Chibhabha blocks this towards silly point.
Continues to flight this full and into the stumps. Chamu Chibhabha clips this towards deep mid-wicket and they complete two runs.
Gudakesh Motie flights this one full and into the pads. Chamu Chibhabha dabs this to the right of the bowler.
Continues with the short ball and outside off. Innocent Kaia gets behind the line of the ball and punches this towards mid on.

FOUR! SMACK! Innocent Kaia dispatches this out of sight! Jason Holder bangs this in short and outside off. Innocent Kaia gets on top of the bounce and pulls this towards deep square leg for four runs.
Gets this one to nip back in from outside off and on a good length. Chamu Chibhabha clips this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length this time and outside off. Chamu Chibhabha stands tall and punches this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this one slightly back of a length and outside the off pole. Chamu Chibhabha rocks back and punches this towards cover.
Jason Holder bowls this short and well outside the off stump. Chamu Chibhabha gets on his toes and slaps this straight to point.
Another flighted delivery served outside the off pole. Innocent Kaia pushes at this and gets it off the outside edge towards backward point.
A loopy delivery bowled wide outside off on a fuller length. Innocent Kaia reaches for it and thumps it towards deep cover for a single.
Fires this one full and angles this into the stumps. Innocent Kaia digs this one out back towards the bowler.
Tosses this one full as well and outside the off stump. Innocent Kaia defends this to the short cover fielder.
Flighted full and outside off. Innocent Kaia blocks this towards cover.
Gudakesh Motie floats this one full and angling down leg. Innocent Kaia shapes up for the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. The appeal is turned down by the umpire.
Keeps bowling in line with the stumps on a good length. Chamu Chibhabha flicks this towards mid-wicket.
This is on a good length as well but stays low and is heading for the stumps. Chamu Chibhabha gets his bat down in time and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Continues to bowl on a hood length and attacks the stumps. Chamu Chibhabha dabs this into the leg side.
On a good length and in line with the stumps. Chamu Chibhabha clips this towards square leg.
Attacks the pads once again with a good-length delivery. Innocent Kaia tucks this to the right of the square-leg fielder and sets off for a quick single.
Jason Holder starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery on a leg stump line. Chamu Chibhabha flicks this towards deep square leg for a single.
Back to bowling short and outside off. Innocent Kaia dabs this to backward point and ends the over with a dot ball.
Flights this full and just outside the off stump. Innocent Kaia taps this to the left of the bowler.
Short this time and outside the off stump. Chamu Chibhabha punches this wide of cover for a run.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Chamu Chibhabha blocks this towards cover.
Continues to bowl full and in line with the stumps. Innocent Kaia punches this down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Great use of the feet! Gudakesh Motie floats this one full and into the pads. Innocent Kaia shimmied down the wicket and lofts this towards wide long on for four runs. Zimbabwe showing positive intent here.
Bangs this one in short and going down leg side. Innocent Kaia swivels and gets into position quickly as he pulls this towards fine leg for a run.
Continues to bowl full and this time outside off. Chamu Chibhabha looks to drive this through the off side but miscues his shot towards mid-wicket for a single.
Decides to bowl full but strays down leg. Chamu Chibhabha is unable to glance this fine and the keeper collects this one.
Bowls this slightly back of a length and straight. Chamu Chibhabha taps this down into the pitch towards short leg.
Goes full this time and angles this down leg. Chamu Chibhabha misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards square leg.
Alzarri Joseph bowls this back of a length and in line with the stumps. Chamu Chibhabha gets on his toes and dabs this into the pitch.
Tossed up, full and on off, Innocent Kaia dives it towards short covers where the fielder dives to his left to stop it.
Floated, full and on middle, Innocent Kaia keeps it out towards short leg.
Quicker, full and on middle, Innocent Kaia works it with the inner half towards square leg.
Short and outside off, Chamu Chibhabha moves back and cuts it towards deep point for a run.
Flighted, full and on middle, Innocent Kaia tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Innocent Kaia blocks it out.
Fuller one and on middle, Chamu Chibhabha mistimes his drive towards mid on.

EDGED AND FOUR! Alzarri Joseph bowls this on a good length and around off, Chamu Chibhabha looks to drive it on the up, but gets an outside edge towards the right of the keeper where Kyle Mayers at first slip dives to his left, but fails to get to it as the ball races to the third man fence for a boundary. Joshua Da Silva should have done better there as it was a keeper's catch.
Oh..that is close! Alzarri Joseph serves this full again and outside off, Chamu Chibhabha slashes at it, but gets a bottom edge as the ball just goes past the stumps.
Goes fuller and around leg, Chamu Chibhabha misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards the keeper.
Back of a length and and on middle, Chamu Chibhabha works it towards square leg.
Alzarri Joseph bangs in a short delivery, on middle and leg, Chamu Chibhabha ducks under it.
Gives this one some air, on off, Innocent Kaia is solid in his defence again.
Pushed through quicker, on middle, Innocent Kaia turns it to the right of the bowler.
Flighted, full and on middle, Chamu Chibhabha drills it towards mid on and scampers across for a run.
Floated, full and on off, Chamu Chibhabha defends it on the front foot.
Flatter, full and on leg, Innocent Kaia eases it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Innocent Kaia leans on and tries to defend, but gets an inside edge onto his pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down.

What happened there? Alzarri Joseph tries to bang in a short ball, on off, but it keeps really low and does not bounce at all, Chamu Chibhabha sways away from it as the ball goes just over the off pole.
Alzarri Joseph serves this full and on thepads, Innocent Kaia whips it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
This is on a good length and on middle, Innocent Kaia flicks it towards square leg.
Alzarri Joseph bangs in a bouncer, on leg, Innocent Kaia ducks underneath it.
Touch fuller and on middle, Innocent Kaia turns it towards short mif-wicket.
Alzarri Joseph begins with a back-of-a-length delivery, on middle, and leg, Innocent Kaia tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
Alzarri Joseph has been brought into the attack now.
Tosses this one full and outside the off stump. Chamu Chibhabha knocks this back towards the bowler.
Fires this full and into the pads. Chamu Chibhabha looks to clip this away but misses and gets hit on the pads. Loud appeal from the players but the umpire remains unmoved.
Flatter, full and on middle, Innocent Kaia clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up, full and on middle, Innocent Kaia digs it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middel, Innocent Kaia looks to defend it, but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
TURN AND BOUNCE! Gudakesh Motie gives this one some air, on off, turning away sharply, Innocent Kaia gets beaten on the outside edge as he leans on to defend.
Full again and on off, Chamu Chibhabha defends it towards mid off.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Chamu Chibhabha knocks it towards mid on.

FOUR! Chamu Chibhabha finds the fence this time! Kemar Roach bowls another short delivery, on off, Chamu Chibhabha stays there and just pushes it gently at it. The timing is so good that it races to the sweeper cover fence for a boundary.
Back of a length and around off, Chamu Chibhabha punches it through cover-point for a brace.
Length again and on off, Innocent Kaia steers it towards point for a quick single.
Kemar Roach is struggling with his line! He bowls this on a hard length but way down the leg side, Innocent Kaia leaves it alone.
Quicker one, on off, Chamu Chibhabha gets forward and keeps it out towards slip.
Floated, full and on off, Chamu Chibhabha blocks it out.
Chamu Chibhabha makes his way out to the crease at number 3.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Gudakesh Motie draws first blood! Tanunurwa Makoni goes back to the hut for a low score this time. Gudakesh Motie flights this one up, full and on off, turning away sharply, Tanunurwa Makoni tries to drive it away, but well away from his body. The turn away takes the outside edge and Joshua Da Silva takes a sharp catch behind the stumps. Zimbabwe lose their first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Joshua Da Silva b Gudakesh Motie

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and on off, Tanunurwa Makoni drills it hard, but it hits Raymon Reifer at silly point and goes nowhere. That must have hurt him as it was powerfully hit.
Short and outside off, Tanunurwa Makoni cuts it but straight to point.
Tossed up, full and on off, Innocent Kaia drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish one and on middle, Tanunurwa Makoni works it towards short mid-wicket.
Kemar Roach bowls this on a hard length and on off, shaping in, Tanunurwa Makoni looks to defend, but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Length again and on the pads, Innocent Kaia misses his flick as the ball deflects off his pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
This is on a good length and around leg, angling in, Innocent Kaia heaves across the line, but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW, but turned down.
Full again and on the pads, Tanunurwa Makoni flicks it through square leg for a single.
Fuller one and on middle, Tanunurwa Makoni knocks it towards mid on.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Innocent Kaia blocks this towards silly point.
Floats this one full and outside the off stump. Innocent Kaia pushes this towards point.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Innocent Kaia cuts it towards deep point where a fumble allows the second run.
Flatter, full and on middle, Innocent Kaia pushes it towards mid on.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Innocent Kaia prods forward and blocks it out.
Gudakesh Motie begins with a floated delivery, short and outsid eoff, Innocent Kaia chops it onto the keeper's pads.
Gudakesh Motie will share the attack and bowl from the other end.
FOUR! SMASHED! Kemar Roach bowls this short and outside off, Tanunurwa Makoni accepts the width on offer and crunches it through point for a boundary.
Fullish one and on middle, shaping in, Tanunurwa Makoni drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly punished! Kemar Roach bangs this short and but down the leg side, Tanunurwa Makoni pulls it with the bottom half towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.

We are back for the final session of the Test match and the clouds have cleared away as the umpires and the West Indies players stride out to the middle. Innocent Kaia and Tanunurwa Makoni will resume their opening stand which was interrupted after just 3 balls. Kemar Roach will finish the first over and the good news is no overs have been lost with this break. Let's go...
... DAY 5, SESSION 3 ...

Update - 5.41 pm IST (12.09 pm GMT) - Good news folks! The covers are being taken off now! Also, the umpires decided to take Tea at 5.40 pm IST (12.10 pm GMT) to make up the time lost due to the rain-stoppage. The match is at an interesting phase at the moment and it will test the patience of both teams. The news from the middle is that the game will restart at 6 pm IST (12.30 pm GMT).
Goes full this time, on middle, Tanunurwa Makoni blocks it down the pitch.

There comes the rain! The umpires immediately call for the ground staff to bring the covers on and get them on the main patch. The players are not running off the field so the rain does not appear to be very heavy and we hope that this will not be a delayed interruption. Stay tuned for further updates.
This is on a hard length and outside off, Tanunurwa Makoni leaves it alone.

Zimbabwe are underway straightaway! Kemar Roach starts with a good-length delivery, on middle, shaping in sharply, Innocent Kaia gets hurried as the ball goes off his pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
